messages:
auditor-maria: Hi team — during ISO fieldwork the auditor flagged a recent finding: a failed automated KMS rotation in prod left an old keyVersion active longer than our documented window. They want control mapping (which control detects/limits this), a timeline of the incident, rotation logs, IAM grants that could've bypassed rotation, the vuln triage notes, and any exception approvals. What can we pull quickly?

sam: Acknowledged. Short answer: CloudTrail + KMS key state history + IAM credential report + incident ticket. We operate on AWS for KMS in this region, so we can pull key rotation events (RotateKey, UpdateKeyDescription) and GenerateDataKey calls to show usage after rotation.

tanya: Auditor wants to see which control this maps to (ISO A.9/A.12 or SOC2 CC6/CC7). Proposed mapping:
- Detection: CloudTrail event rule + CloudWatch alarm (control owner: infra-security) -> maps to ISO A.12.4.1 / SOC2 CC6.
- Preventive: IAM least privilege for the service principal + KMS key policy restricting Decrypt to current keyVersion -> maps to ISO A.9.2.3 / SOC2 CC7.

auditor-maria: Good. Please include the exact CloudTrail filters and the ticket that shows remediation. Auditor also wants proof that a prior exception was approved (if any) and who signed off.

sam: Plan to deliver: (1) rotation timeline (CreateKey/RotateKey events), (2) list of GenerateDataKey/Decrypt calls tied to principal and requestId (post-rotation usage), (3) IAM role binding change events (who changed policies), (4) incident triage notes + remediation commit + exception approval if present, (5) short test demonstrating rejected Decrypt with revoked key policy in a sandbox.

sam: Quick CloudTrail event filter example (AWS CLI):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2025-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z
```
And for data key usage:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
```
(we'll correlate with our app request_id present in CloudWatch logs).

tanya: Runbook for evidence pack:
1) Export CloudTrail events for the key resource (CreateKey, RotateKey, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion).
2) Export CloudWatch logs for app request_ids that show GenerateDataKey/Encrypt/Decrypt after the rotation timestamp.
3) Pull IAM change events (AWS CloudTrail: PutRolePolicy/AttachRolePolicy) for the service principal.
4) Snapshot KMS key policy versions and the account-level IAM policy at the time.
5) Attach the incident ticket (INC-4582) with triage notes and remediation PR link.
6) If exception existed, include approval email or ticket comment.

infra-bot: export-task queued: ct-export-1876012345, logs export + kms-policy-snapshots, ETA 20m :gear:

auditor-maria: Auditor follow-ups: they want a short written statement from the control owner confirming that detection alarm was firing and why rotation failed (root cause). Also need confirmation that post-remediation we've added an automated test to prevent recurrence.

sam: I'll ask infra-security for a 1-paragraph attestation and a reference to the new CI test (ci/tests/kms_rotation_check.py) added in PR #912.

tanya: Note on redaction: we will not include raw plaintext. Deliverables will be logs, event IDs, hashed payloads (sha256) that allow auditor to confirm data link without seeing content.

auditor-maria: OK — timeline requested: deliver these artifacts + control attestation within 72 hours. If any policy/exception proof requires manager approval to share, we'll pause and auditor will be notified.

sam: Understood. We'll compile artifacts and post back when ct-export completes. If anyone sees blockers (legal/PII), ping auditor-maria directly.

oncall-bot: export completed: ct-export-1876012345 at 1876012480, artifacts: cloudtrail_rotations.csv, cloudtrail_usage.csv, kms_policy_snapshots.tar.gz, iam_changes.csv, incident_INC-4582.md :white_check_mark:

sam: Uploading artifact bundle to secure share and creating scrub ticket (SEC-TR-789) to delete sandbox copies after review. ETA for package: 36 hours.

auditor-maria: Thanks — once package is in place I will review and call out any gaps. Appreciate quick turnaround.
